ac2.defect: Reload or repeated activation duplicates listeners, authorities, background work or processes

evidence.test: reload or repeated activation does not duplicate registrations
evidence.proves: deactivate disposes the session; a later activate starts a new generation instead of stacking
concurrent activate() callers still share one in-flight start

evidence.test: stops a started client that deactivates before runtime publication
evidence.proves: a failed language-server start attempt still disposes its own registrations, and a start that finishes after the post-start guard still cannot publish an ownerless process

ac3.note: ARH7 does not mutate a compiler state, query or map boundary. Language-server start-attempt cancellation, disposal and activation-generation stale rejection are the touched lifetime concerns; compiler map/query stay with their existing owners.

concerns.rationale: no incremental compile cache, query memo or generation supersession is touched; activation owns host registrations and process lifetime only
no edit transaction or source-revision boundary is touched

evidence.test: releases every subscription, status bar item and armed timer when a start attempt fails

concerns.note: a failed or disposed start attempt still cannot hand the workspace an ownerless server

evidence.test: a stale activation's success cannot republish its runtime
a stale activation's rejection cannot dispose or replace the live session
a superseded attempt's late rejection does not unlock a third start

concerns.note: activation generations fence stale completions; a superseded run cannot dispose, replace or republish over the live session

concerns.concern: deterministic ordering under perturbed discovery or scheduling
concerns.rationale: no discovery or scheduler ordering boundary is touched

ac5Rationale: No new latency/work/allocation/RSS budget is created. The obsolete module-level locator and in-file StartAttemptScope are retired; required work is not removed — language-server start, MCP child lifetime, heartbeat watchdog, restart supervisor and TypeScript plugin forwarding remain.
